from datetime import datetime, timezone
from delta.tables import DeltaTable

config = load_config(config_uri)
work_items = json.loads(work_items_json)

spark.conf.set("spark.sql.session.timeZone", "UTC")

manifest_path = build_storage_path(
    config,
    "monitoring",
    config["paths"]["monitoring"]["ingestion_manifest"]
)

manifest_df = spark.read.format("delta").load(manifest_path)

records = []

for item in work_items:
    target_directory = build_storage_path(
        config,
        "bronze",
        item["target_directory"]
    )

    target = next(
        f for f in mssparkutils.fs.ls(target_directory)
        if f.isFile and f.name == item["file_name"]
    )

    assert target.size == item["file_size_bytes"]

    records.append({
        "dataset_id": item["dataset_id"],
        "file_name": item["file_name"],
        "source_path": item["source_path"],
        "target_path": target.path,
        "file_size_bytes": item["file_size_bytes"],
        "last_modified": datetime.fromisoformat(
            item["last_modified"]
        ).replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc),
        "source_month": None,
        "batch_id": pipeline_run_id,
        "pipeline_run_id": pipeline_run_id,
        "ingested_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        "status": "SUCCESS",
        "error_message": None

if records:
    updates_df = spark.createDataFrame(
        records,
        manifest_df.schema
    )

    (
        DeltaTable.forPath(spark, manifest_path)
        .alias("t")
        .merge(
            updates_df.alias("s"),
            """
            t.pipeline_run_id = s.pipeline_run_id
            AND t.dataset_id = s.dataset_id
            AND t.source_path = s.source_path
            """
        )
        .whenNotMatchedInsertAll()
        .execute()
    )

print("Validated files:", len(records))
